referenceSources.title: La increíble historia del Mitsubishi 3000 GT
referenceSources.description:
The image features a silver Mitsubishi 3000 GT sports coupe viewed from the rear, showcasing its active rear spoiler, quad exhaust outlets, and continuous taillight strip emblazoned with the GTO badge. The car’s smooth, aerodynamic bodywork and integrated wing reflect the advanced design elements that defined Japanese performance cars of the early 1990s.

This 2+2 coupe, produced between 1990 and 2000, combined permanent all-wheel drive, four-wheel steering, and adaptive suspension in a 4.60-meter-long chassis. Under the hood, twin-turbo V6 variants delivered up to 320 CV, while the base model featured a 225 CV naturally aspirated engine. Despite its weight and electronic quirks, the 3000 GT remains a sought-after classic, with special editions like the lightweight MR and the Spyder convertible adding to its legacy.
